CustomField.formula:
IF( TRUE,
IF ( (Number_of_Tasks_To_Complete__c==0 || Number_of_Tasks_Completed__c == 0), IMAGE("/resource/white_progress_100", "white", 15, 100) & ' 0%',
IF ( (Number_of_Tasks_To_Complete__c == Number_of_Tasks_Completed__c), IMAGE("/resource/blue_progress_100", "green", 15, 100) & ' 100%',
IMAGE("/resource/blue_progress", "green", 15, IF ( Number_of_Tasks_To_Complete__c==0, 0,
( (Number_of_Tasks_Completed__c)/Number_of_Tasks_To_Complete__c )*100 ) ) & IMAGE("/resource/white_progress", "white", 15, 100 - (IF(Number_of_Tasks_To_Complete__c==0, 0,( (Number_of_Tasks_Completed__c)/Number_of_Tasks_To_Complete__c)*100) )) & ' ' & TEXT(ROUND(IF(Number_of_Tasks_To_Complete__c==0,0,( (Number_of_Tasks_Completed__c)/Number_of_Tasks_To_Complete__c)*100),0)) & '%') ),
IF(Number_of_Tasks_To_Complete__c==0 || (Number_of_Tasks_Completed__c) == 0,IMAGE("/resource/white_progress_100", "white", 15, 100) & ' 0%', IF(Number_of_Tasks_To_Complete__c == (Number_of_Tasks_Completed__c),IMAGE("/resource/blue_progress_100", "green", 15, 100) & ' 100%', IMAGE("/resource/blue_progress", "green", 15, IF(Number_of_Tasks_To_Complete__c==0,0,( (Number_of_Tasks_Completed__c)/Number_of_Tasks_To_Complete__c)*100)) & IMAGE("/resource/white_progress", "white", 15, 100 - (IF(Number_of_Tasks_To_Complete__c==0,0,( (Number_of_Tasks_Completed__c)/Number_of_Tasks_To_Complete__c)*100) ))& ' ' & TEXT(ROUND(IF(Number_of_Tasks_To_Complete__c==0,0,( (Number_of_Tasks_Completed__c)/Number_of_Tasks_To_Complete__c)*100),0)) & '%')) )
CustomField.label: Progress
